name: Business Strategy & Analysis
new_description: Delve into the intricate world of business strategy and analysis. Explore how organizations navigate complex market environments, make informed decisions, and drive sustainable growth. Examine cutting-edge concepts such as competitive analysis, resource allocation, and performance measurement. Gain insights into the economic theories and organizational behavior principles that underpin strategic planning and decision-making. Develop the critical thinking skills needed to assess a company's competitive position, identify new opportunities, and formulate effective strategies for long-term success.
focus_areas: Competitive analysis, Resource management, Performance metrics, Economic theories, Organizational behavior

name: Physics
new_description: Dive into the fascinating world of physics! Explore the laws that govern how the universe works, from the tiniest particles to the grandest galaxies. Discover the hidden forces that make objects move, how energy transforms from one type to another, and the strange behavior of waves that carry light and sound. Uncover the mysteries of heat, electricity, and magnetism, and learn about the cutting-edge field of quantum physics. With physics, you'll gain a deeper understanding of the physical world around you and the extraordinary principles that shape our reality.
focus_areas: motion and forces, energy transformations, wave phenomena, electromagnetism, quantum mechanics
